result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Pack a directory of files into an asset bundle

USAGE:
    gondwana pack <source> <output> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    gondwana pack ./Assets ./game.assets

ARGUMENTS:
    <source>    The source directory containing files to pack            
    <output>    The output asset file path (e.g. game.assets or game.gaf)

OPTIONS:
                      DEFAULT                                                   
    -h, --help                   Prints help information                        
    -t, --type        Misc       Default asset type for files whose type cannot 
                                 be inferred (default: Misc)                    
    -r, --recurse     True       Recurse into subdirectories (default: true)    
    -a, --append                 Append to an existing bundle instead of        
                                 overwriting it (default: false)                
    -m, --type-map               Path to a JSON file that maps asset types to   
                                 file extensions. Defaults to                   
                                 'gondwana-asset-types.json' in the current     
                                 directory or next to the executable            
    -p, --password               Password to protect the bundle. Required when  
                                 --encrypt is specified                         
    -e, --encrypt                Encrypt the bundle using AES-256. Requires     
                                 --password <value> to be specified

DESCRIPTION:

USAGE:
    gondwana publish itch [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    gondwana publish itch
    gondwana publish itch --project ./src/MyGame --skip-build

OPTIONS:
                           DEFAULT                                              
    -h, --help                        Prints help information                   
    -p, --project                     Path to the .csproj file or directory     
                                      containing a single .csproj. Defaults to  
                                      the current directory                     
    -c, --configuration    Release    Build configuration. Defaults to 'Release'
    -o, --output                      Output zip path. Defaults to              
                                      bin/<Configuration>/net8.0-browser/browser
                                      -wasm/<ProjectName>-itch.zip              
        --skip-build                  Skip the dotnet publish step and package  
                                      an existing AppBundle                     
        --skip-workload               Skip 'dotnet workload install wasm-tools' 
                                      during the publish step

DESCRIPTION:
Pack a directory of files into an asset bundle

USAGE:
    gondwana assets pack <source> <output> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    gondwana assets pack ./Assets ./game.assets

ARGUMENTS:
    <source>    The source directory containing files to pack            
    <output>    The output asset file path (e.g. game.assets or game.gaf)

OPTIONS:
                      DEFAULT                                                   
    -h, --help                   Prints help information                        
    -t, --type        Misc       Default asset type for files whose type cannot 
                                 be inferred (default: Misc)                    
    -r, --recurse     True       Recurse into subdirectories (default: true)    
    -a, --append                 Append to an existing bundle instead of        
                                 overwriting it (default: false)                
    -m, --type-map               Path to a JSON file that maps asset types to   
                                 file extensions. Defaults to                   
                                 'gondwana-asset-types.json' in the current     
                                 directory or next to the executable            
    -p, --password               Password to protect the bundle. Required when  
                                 --encrypt is specified                         
    -e, --encrypt                Encrypt the bundle using AES-256. Requires     
                                 --password <value> to be specified
